Part!-C

201- Odontology!. Study of teeth is called odontology.

Role in Mass disaster situations
Odontology is very reliable evidence in forensic investigation because it has characteristics like!.
- No two individual have same teeth size.
- Morphology is vary person to person.
- Size & shape also vary person to person.
- we can extract dna from the teeth so that we find the personal identity of a person.
- It Everyone have unique pattern.

In Mass disaster situation forensic experts follow steps are as follow.
- They compare 1000 to 100 of Post Mortem & Ante-Mortem data of the teeth.
- By comparing find out the personal identity of a person.
- In mass disaster we found many part of be to skilled of different person.

--- Page 3 ---
Dental Records are very helpful to find out the accurate victim Identification.

We have 3 steps include in it:-
1. Post Mortem
2. Ante Mortem
3. Dental Comparison Or Comparing Identification

Post Mortem :- Take out the body from
2. Then take photographs & videos
3. Then Record all the data about the teeth.
4. Then extract the Dental teeth from the skull.
Then further examine the dental Records.

Ante-Mortem :- It is the Most difficult step.
- It is done in very short time of period.
- It is not accurate properly.
- By the help of Relative, family member collect all the data about the individual.

--- Page 4 ---
Dental comparing identification :- Compar both anti-mortem and post-mortem data.

we can extract DNA from teeth by which we can find the part remaining part belong to which part family.
There are 2 method of extract DNA.
1. Lysonial method :- In the teeth is cool down in the temperate
Then grind it and Made the powder of this part.

2. Grinding method :- In this teeth are grinding
The pulpal part of the teeth is grind by mechanical or forensic needle.

Facial Reconstruction
Facial Reconstruction technique is used to reconstruct the face of a person to find out their personal identity.

There are various Facial superimposition techniques called these! Superimposition

--- Page 5 ---
1. Photography superimposition! In this superimposition we have to take a photograph of a person before death to match the details of the present a post Mortem & ante Mortem data.

Strength! - It is easy to and give accurate result.
It help to find out the personal identity of a person.
It help in mass disaster case.

Limitation! - It is very time consuming.
It is very difficult to collect ante Mortem photograph of a person.

2. Videography superimposition! - In this we take a live video or a video recording of person before death by which we can compare their facial structure or features of a person.

strength! - It help to find out the identity of person that in video & in the after Post Mortem. If details are same the person's personal identity will be known.

--- Page 6 ---
limitation! - It has very high chances of mistake
It did not give 100% accurate results.

3. Radiography superimposition! - On this we compare the X-Rays of a skull.
By
strength! - By this we can get the scar marks and other details of the face.
It help to recognize the person from the skull.

limitation! - It is very time consuming
It do not make accurate face because we did not know the shape and the features like tissue depth so overall feature is not known.
It is very difficult to find out the X-Rays of a unknown person.

Their use in both confirmed and disputed identity cases that if we have a confirmed case we also have the Ante-mortem data of a person so it become easy to

--- Page 7 ---
Reconstruct the face easily but in some cases like dispute identity cases we have to make a facial reconstruction By our measurement & idea it does not accurate result but we get the clue that the skull belongs to that person.

Somatometric measurement
In this we have to measure the length breadth of a bone of the skeleton of every persons
we have many instrument to measure these
1. anthropometer
2. sliding calipers etc.

we have different formula for each part of the face. like:
1. Head
For the measurement we need Cephalic index

Formula : head length / head breadth x 100

--- Page 8 ---
2. Nose
For Nose we have nasal Index.

Formula = Nose height / Nose breadth x 100

3. Face
For face we have facial index.

Formula = Face breadth / Face height x 100

4. Ear
For ear we measure height of the ear
and the shape I note that the ear lobe is attached
or not.

By these formulas and by these methods we can get
the accurate result and made a Facial feature
of person to find out the personal identity

--- Page 9 ---
It is reliable but not 100%, because the estimation we could not make accurate face of a person but we can get the idea of the identity of the person.

In forensic examination it has very important in the cases like mass murder disaster or burned cases we did not have the body of the person so by this we can identify the person's identity

Skull
Skull is a part of the skeletal which provide shape to the face of a person
It also protect the brain
It is very hard in nature
By the help of skull we can determine the sex of a person.

Features Male Female
General Appearance large small

--- Page 10 ---
Architecture Rigged Rough
Supra orbital Highly pronounced less pronounced
Orbit Round with Sharp margin Rectangle with sharp margin
Gonial angle Acute Obtuse
Cheek shape Round oval
zygomatic bone more prominent less prominent
head bigger smaller
Robusticity Highly pronounced less pronounced
Nasal cavity Sharp sharp & pointed Triangular
Frontal eminences Small large
supra orbital Thin & smooth Thick & smooth
Ramus height large small
Ramus structure flattened Rough
Size bigger smaller

By these characteristics we can differential the difference btw the Male & the female skull. If we get characteristics similar to female then it is female or vice versa.

15.2 Facial Reconstruction
Facial Reconstruction is a process in which we can find

--- Page 14 ---
Out the personal identity of person by reconstructed their face from skull

Facial Reconstruction is of 3 types
1. 2D Facial Reconstruction
2. 3D Facial Reconstruction
3. Superimposition

2D Facial Reconstruction! In this we construct the face by the clay models or by stamp the pro sketching form.

3D Facial Reconstruction! In this we construct the image by computer.

Superimposition! In this we impose the photograph & match the facial features of the person.

Factors that affect the Facial Reconstruction
• Time gap: The time gap become more so we could not remember the face.

--- Page 15 ---
• Lightening ! it create lot of affect in creating constructing a image
• Memory loss
• Traumatized
• Change in facial features.

These are features which make difficult to construct a face.

In this we have both digital & manual methods

Digital
• It is helpful
in nowadays a lot of AI tool or software are launched to me for Facial reconstruction
• It is more give accurate result
• It is more reliable
• It is less time consuming.

Manual
• It is done in past years where we did not have time
• It take lot of time to make faces.
• It did not give accurate results
• It is not 100% reliable.

--- Page 16 ---
|4-1| Portrait Parlé (Bertillon System):
In this system we can mention the detail detail of the criminals for further investigation.
In this system we can take the photograph in different view 1. Front view (close-up image)
2. Right side view
3. Left side view
It is invented by Alphonse Bertillon in 1950
In this the criminal were write their detail on the board and so after that we take photographs with board of them.
After this a Report is made in which all the details are mentioned with photograph.

Biometric methods:
In this system we record finger prints of a person criminal for further examination.
In this we take fingerprints and eye scan to identify the personal identification because finger prints are never same of two person

--- Page 17 ---
It is a individual characteristic.

Strength Diff:

Bertillon
- It is used in past when the technology is not develop properly.
- It does not reliable because any person can change them.
- Face also not have same life due to some issue it may be changed.
- It is time consuming.
- It is not reliable in court because any one can edit the images.

Biometric
- It is new technology which is used nowadays.
- It is more reliable because every person have their unique prints.
- It does not change by the passing of time it remain same till death.
- It is very less time consuming.
- It is reliable in court.
- Access to this is not easy.

13.2 Somazometry
It is a technique to take the measurement of the bone of the skull.
By this record we can reconstruct the face of a person for identification.

$\Rightarrow$ we have many tools to mean take measurements
- Anthropometers
- Flexible tape
- Sliding caliper
- Vernier caliper
- measuring tape
- Scale

$\Rightarrow$ we have different formula for different part of the bone like for head we used Cephalic index.
- Nose = Nasal index
- Face = Facial index
and we also include various features like ear or to other part to make the facial Reco

--- Page 20 ---
Forensic Significance.
By this we can find out the measurement of bone & we can get the accurate face of a person.
In cases like mass arrests and burned case if the identity is unknown of a person we can get to know the personal identification of a person.

Formulas

Cephalic Index = (Head breadth / Head length) x 100

Nasal Index = (Nose height / Nose breadth) x 100

Facial Index = (Face breadth / Face height) x 100

By these index we can get the measurement.

Anthropology
It is a study of bones
The father of anthropology is options daphne, Baudillon

Forensic Significance
In forensic science anthropology plays very important role like in the cases where we can only get the skeletal it becomes very difficult to solve the case or get the identity of a person or there are some case that reopen solve there no dead body or any thing related to victim so we have to use the skeletal or bones of the person for examination
By the anthropology we can get many informations like
By dental we can get DNA
By skull we can get to know the age estimation & sex determination
By the skull we also reconstructed the face of a person it help to find out the personal identification of person
By pelvis we can determine the sex.
By long bones we can get to know height estimation.
